text:
jamie: Quick sync — final prod onboarding criteria (SLA/pricing/docs/monitoring/support). Need owners + blockers by EOD. Triage points: 1) SLA targets 2) Pricing tiers & early customer credits 3) Canary plan/runbook 4) Monitoring queries & alert thresholds 5) Support handoff.
sofia: Finance flagged pricing tiers — they want predictable per-request buckets for pilot vs enterprise. Ask: can we propose a 'pilot' discounted tier for first 3 months? Also need projected per-request cost at 95th pct traffic.
kevin: Ops: 99.9% for Hosted sounds okay; Dedicated 99.95% is feasible but only with dedicated pool + 2 standby nodes. We'll need autoscale policy + capacity tests. Also require oncall RTO = 15m and runbook link: <internal link>.
maria: I'll own docs & runbook. Pull request draft in progress. Need canonical smoke-test cURL and example PromQL for SLO checks. Proposed smoke test:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwt-large","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.output'
```
ashley: Customer asks: Enterprise A insists on data residency + SLA penalty clause. Legal will need exact SLO wording. Also they want canary rollback triggers (error rate > 1% 5m) and fallback to quantized model.
kevin: Monitoring snippet for p95 latency:
`histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`
Alert -> p95 > 500ms for 10m -> page.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: region=us-west-2, traffic=8%, tag=canary-20260322-1
jamie: Action items (owners):
- SLA text + legal review: ashley + legal
- Pricing proposal + cost sims: sofia + fin
- Runbook + smoke tests: maria
- Canary plan + capacity tests: kevin
Please update the doc with checklist ticks. If any blockers call out now. :eyes:
sofia: I'll run cost sims and drop numbers by 4pm.
maria: Draft PR link: <internal PR link> — adding smoke tests and sample telemetry queries.
kevin: Scheduling capacity soak tomorrow 02:00–06:00 UTC. Will report results here.
ashley: I'll coordinate legal for penalty wording, ETA EOD tomorrow.
jamie: Great. If no major blockers by EOD we'll greenlight the canary expansion. :thumbsup:
